purpose: Prospectively diagnose whether a future positive same-order paired transfer increment is broad across taxonomic orders or dominated by one response-blind order. This diagnostic cannot change, rescue, or overturn the frozen species-equal primary decision.
primary_estimand_unchanged: species-equal mean of C_same_order_geo - C_geo over the frozen same-order-supported evaluation set

breadth_diagnostic.order_balanced_statistic: equal-weight mean of within-order mean paired increments among orders with at least 5 eligible evaluation species
breadth_diagnostic.leave_one_order_out: species-equal primary increment recomputed descriptively after removing each target order in turn
breadth_diagnostic.claim_limit: A positive primary result does not by itself establish generality across taxonomic orders. Breadth summaries describe concentration only.

interpretation.primary_positive_breadth_consistent: same-order transfer improvement is not confined to the numerically dominant target order under the frozen descriptive diagnostics
interpretation.primary_positive_breadth_concentrated: same-order transfer improvement is concentrated in one or a small number of orders; report the primary result at the supported-species level and do not generalize it across orders
interpretation.primary_null: breadth diagnostics cannot rescue a non-significant primary result
